nodes.text: Good evening. Let's reflect on your day.
When something didn’t go as planned today, what was your first reaction?

options.label: I thought about what I could have done differently
I felt frustrated by things outside my control
I adapted and found another way
I waited for someone else to fix it

nodes.text: You showed signs of ownership today. Recognizing your agency is the first step toward growth.
Difficult days can make everything feel external. Reflection helps us notice where small choices still existed.
